scope: Cold untracked historical binary/input/resource snapshots only, at least1MiB. Current frozen inputs and open/mapped files, Git-tracked files, source/metadata, current qualification, forensic originals and existing archives excluded. Preserve every unique byte and original file mode/mtime/owner/group in a local compressed content-addressed archive; remove only verified expanded copies. All old paths are recoverable with this script; no overwrite of newer state, Git history rewrite or system capability change.
